\*\\*\    My purpose for this guide is to make sure that you are able    /*//*/
 )*))*)   to get a perfect game, meaning that you can find all items,   (*((*(
/*//*/      explore all of the areas, and see all there is to see.       \*\\*\
¯¯¯¯¯                                                                     ¯¯¯¯¯


For this guide, I have decided to create an extensive FAQ/Walkthrough. The
walkthrough is the main focus; it walks you through the whole game step-by-
step, leading you to the locations of all of the items in the game and
strategies for fighting the bosses. It will also be an extensive FAQ, which
includes lists of all of the items, equipment, skills, shop lists, a bestiary
with all of the enemies in the game, and more!
